message:
docs(comments): three numbers that were being read as more than they are

Comments only; no behaviour changes.

- The observe-fetch cooldown is 2, 4, 6 CYCLES of the host loop, not seconds. At
  the default 25 s heartbeat that is off by more than an order of magnitude if
  read as seconds, and it was written without the unit.
- After the attempt budget is spent, the asking stops for the rest of the
  process's life. A directory given an observe port later is not picked up and
  the host has to be restarted. That is the intended bound, but it is not
  permanent self-recovery and the comment now says so instead of implying it.
- The 5,997 ms shutdown figure is what one fixture measured against a loopback
  server that accepts and never answers. It is a point on the stated bound, not a
  ceiling for every https destination.

Raised by Codex in the 0.2.109 review.
